notes:
Speccify 0.11.3 is a Mac patch. Windows remains on 0.11.0; its next planned release is 0.12.0.

- The Inspector keeps the resource you selected while you edit another document or use an Agent. Properties, Infos, Actions and Connections stay at the top of the right sidebar.
- Agent views give their content area to the prompt. Configuration, session selection and controls live in the Inspector. Collection actions, including Workstations and Task sessions, are there too.
- Features are current Markdown documents without product-version bindings or a separate timeline. Graphical Models and product Versions retain their existing version behavior.
- Local images and files linked in Markdown appear in Connections. Cmd-click opens the exact file in File Editor and reveals its location in the tree.
- New planning versions without a branch no longer depend on another Mac's old checkout path.

Use Environment → Updates to install the Mac patch. Existing catalogs require an explicit Feature-migration preview and confirmation; the original bytes are backed up and conflicting drafts require a choice. All collaborators need compatible clients before migrating a shared catalog.

The Setup and Caffeinate skills are included. A complete fresh-Mac onboarding run with a remote build and Computer Use is still to be verified. Workstations require an unlocked desktop for Computer Use, and host restarts require renewed access approval.
